faq.a: Real payment messages come from our order email or WhatsApp number and contain your order ID. When in doubt, contact us through the website.

faq.a: No. Do not redeem it. Send the details through the private link.

title: Gift Card or Crypto? Which Discounted Payment Fits You
summary: Both earn a 10% discount. Compare speed, effort, fees and privacy considerations to decide between gift cards and cryptocurrency.
body:
Both gift card and crypto payments earn a 10% discount. They suit different people, so here is how to choose.

## Speed
Crypto on a fast network can be confirmed within minutes, and detection is automatic on most networks. Gift cards depend on you buying the card and uploading the details, then us verifying them. Typically crypto is quicker once you hold coins.

## Effort
If you have never used crypto, setting up a wallet or exchange takes time. Gift cards can be bought in minutes from a familiar site. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/) and [how to buy crypto with a card](/blog/how-to-buy-crypto-with-a-card/).

## Fees
Crypto has network fees and exchange fees. Gift cards usually have no extra fee beyond the card price, though some retailers add small charges. Compare the total against the 10% saving.

## Exact amounts
Stablecoins like [USDT](/blog/usdt-erc20-vs-trc20-which-network/) let you send exact amounts. Gift cards come in set amounts, so you may need to round up.

## Reversibility
Crypto transfers are final. Gift cards are also hard to recover once the code is sent. Be careful in both cases.

## Who should use which
- **Already hold crypto:** use crypto.
- **Prefer a familiar checkout:** use a gift card.
- **Want exact amounts:** use stablecoins.

## See the full list
Read [payment methods compared](/blog/payment-methods-compared/) and [the 10% discount guide](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.a: Not in the same checkout. Contact us if you need a custom arrangement.

title: Minimum Order and Free Shipping Explained
summary: We have a $100 minimum order and free shipping from $200 after discount. See how the numbers work with discounts and flat shipping.
body:
Two numbers decide your total at checkout: the minimum order and the free-shipping threshold.

## Minimum order: $100
Checkout requires a product subtotal of at least $100. The cart page shows how much more you need if you fall short.

## Free shipping: $200 or more after discount
Free domestic shipping applies to orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax, for most of the 48 contiguous U.S. states. Orders below that pay a flat shipping fee shown in your order summary.

## How the discount interacts
If you pay with crypto or a gift card, you get 10% off the product subtotal, and the free-shipping check is applied after that discount. A $210 cart paid with crypto becomes $189 after discount, so it does not qualify. Read the full explanation in [how the 10% discount works](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## Example
- $230 cart, Cash App: no discount, free shipping.
- $230 cart, crypto: $207 after discount, free shipping.
- $215 cart, crypto: $193.50 after discount, flat fee applies.

## Where free shipping does not apply
Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands and APO/DPO/FPO addresses are excluded. We do not ship internationally.

## Plan your order
Combine items to cross the threshold; see [bulk buying tips](/blog/bulk-buying-vapes-save-money/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Check the full [shipping policy](/shipping/) for details. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I place an order under $100?
faq.a: Checkout requires a $100 minimum. Contact us if you have a special request.

faq.q: Is tax included in the free-shipping check?
faq.a: The threshold is measured after discount and before tax.

title: Shipping Times From Phoenix, Arizona: What to Expect
summary: Processing time plus carrier transit equals your delivery time. See our published estimates for the West Coast and the eastern half of the US.
body:
Delivery time has two parts: how long we take to process the order, and how long the carrier takes to deliver it.

## Processing
Orders are processed within 24 to 72 business hours. Most ship within 48 hours. Business days are Monday to Friday, and we do not process orders on weekends or federal holidays.

## Carrier transit
After processing, a tracking email is sent automatically. Our published estimates are:
- **West Coast (Arizona, Nevada, Washington and Idaho):** 3 to 7 business days in transit.
- **Eastern half of the US:** 11 to 18 business days in transit.

## Why times vary
We use regional carriers rather than one national network, so speed depends on where you live. Weather, holidays and adult-signature attempts can add days.

## Planning tips
- Order early if you want a product by a certain date.
- Make sure someone aged 21 or older can sign. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).
- Use a delivery address where someone is usually present, such as a workplace if allowed.

## Delays
If your package is late, read [what to do about a delayed package](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/) and track it using [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## Not shipping to
We do not ship internationally and have limits for some territories; see the full [shipping policy](/shipping/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Why is the eastern half slower?
faq.a: Regional carrier networks take longer to cover the distance from Arizona. Estimates are in our shipping policy.

faq.q: Can I pay for faster shipping?
faq.a: Check the shipping options at checkout. If none appear, standard carrier delivery applies.

title: How to Track Your Order and Understand Each Status
summary: Your order moves through statuses from awaiting payment to shipped. Learn where to see updates and what each message means.
body:
Every order has an ID and a private status page. Here is how to follow it from payment to delivery.

## Your order ID
When you place an order you receive an ID such as OSV-XXXXXX in the confirmation email and on screen. Keep it handy for support.

## Where to look
Use the link in your confirmation email to open the private status page. It shows the amount due, payment instructions where relevant and the current status.

## Status meanings
- **Awaiting payment:** your order is saved and we are waiting for payment or sending you details.
- **Payment details sent:** we have emailed or messaged you how to pay.
- **Proof submitted:** you uploaded a screenshot or gift card details and we are checking them.
- **Payment detected on-chain:** a crypto transfer is visible and awaiting confirmation.
- **Payment confirmed:** we have your payment and the order is being prepared.
- **Shipped:** your package has left, and tracking is on its way.

## Tracking the package
After processing, a tracking email arrives with the carrier and tracking number. Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created.

## No update?
Allow the processing time in the [shipping policy](/shipping/). If it exceeds that, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID. For late packages, see [delayed package steps](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## Tips
Save your confirmation email. Keep your phone number current so the carrier can reach you. Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Where is my tracking number?
faq.a: It is emailed after processing. Check spam folders if you do not see it.

faq.a: Yes. The private link in your email opens it. There is no account required.

title: Adult Signature on Delivery: What to Expect and How to Prepare
summary: Every vape delivery needs an adult signature with photo ID. Here is how the process works and how to avoid missed deliveries.
body:
Packages containing vaping products require adult signature confirmation. This applies in every state.

## What the rule means
The carrier asks the recipient to sign and show government-issued photo identification that confirms they are 21 or older. They compare the ID to the delivery and may record the details.

## Who can sign
An adult aged 21 or over. The recipient name should match the ID where required by the carrier. If another adult is receiving it, tell us in the order notes and check with the carrier.

## Preparing
- Keep a valid photo ID ready.
- Watch your tracking email for the delivery window.
- Consider a workplace address if allowed and someone is usually present.

## If you miss delivery
Carriers typically leave a notice and retry, then return the package. If the package is returned because no one was available to sign, we can issue a refund less the restocking fee and shipping cost, as explained in the [shipping policy](/shipping/).

## Why this exists
It is part of federal and state rules for remote vape sales, covered in our [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/).

## Packaging
Parcels are shipped discreetly in standard packaging; see [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/). Packages carry labels required by law.

## Questions
Ask through the [contact page](/contact/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I have someone else sign for me?
faq.a: Only an adult aged 21 or older with valid ID can accept delivery.

faq.q: Will the carrier accept a digital ID?
faq.a: Carriers usually require a physical government-issued ID. Check with the carrier if unsure.

summary: We ship in plain, standard cartons. Learn what is on the outside, what is on the label and what is inside your package.
body:
Your order arrives in a plain, tough carton without product names or logos on the outside.

## Outside the box
The exterior carries a shipping label with your address and our return address. Federal rules require a label on parcels containing vaping products, which states that federal law requires the payment of applicable excise taxes and compliance with licensing and tax-stamping obligations. This is a legal notice, not a description of the contents.

## Inside the box
Items are packed with padding to reduce damage. Bottles of liquid are sealed and upright where possible. An invoice with your order ID is included.

## Why the label matters
The label is part of rules for remote vape shipments. See our [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/).

## Privacy of your details
We only use your information to fulfill the order and contact you. Read the [privacy policy](/privacy/) for details.

## Opening your parcel
Check the contents against your invoice. If something is damaged, photograph the items and the invoice immediately and email us; see [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

## Storage after delivery
Keep products away from children and pets and out of heat; see [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Returns
Return rules are in the [refund policy](/refunds/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.a: No product names appear outside, but the legal label required for vape shipments is attached.

faq.a: No. The label is a legal requirement for these shipments.

title: Order Status Meanings: Awaiting Payment, Proof Submitted and More
summary: Confused by an order status? This glossary explains each stage, what we are doing and what you may need to do next.
body:
Your private order page shows a status. Each one tells you what is happening and what, if anything, you should do.

## Awaiting payment
We have your order but no confirmed payment. For crypto, make or complete the transfer. For Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime, watch for our details. For gift cards, buy the card and upload it.

## Payment details sent
We emailed or messaged you the details. Pay the exact amount and upload your receipt.

## Proof submitted
You uploaded a screenshot, hash or gift card details. A team member is reviewing it, normally within business hours.

## Payment detected on-chain
For crypto, a transfer is visible on the network but not fully confirmed yet. No action is needed unless it stays that way for a long time.

## Payment confirmed
We have confirmed your payment, and your order enters processing. You receive an email.

## Shipped
Your package is on its way. A tracking email follows. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## Cancelled
The order was cancelled, for example if payment was not received in time.

## What to do if stuck
If an order sits in one status longer than expected, contact us from the [contact page](/contact/) with your ID. Read [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/) for the typical timeline.

## Related
Learn about [uploading proof](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can an order be cancelled automatically?
faq.a: If payment is not received within the period stated in the payment terms, the order may be released.

faq.q: Who changes my status?
faq.a: Some changes are automatic, like on-chain detection, and others are made by our team after review.

summary: Need to swap a flavor, fix an address or cancel? The sooner you contact us, the more we can do. Here is the process.

Before payment is confirmed and the order is processed we can often update flavors, quantities and shipping details. Once an order is processing, changes get harder.

After the package is handed to the carrier, we cannot change the address or contents. See [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/) for in-transit issues.

## How to ask
Contact us right away with your order ID using the [contact page](/contact/), WhatsApp or email. Tell us exactly what to change. We will reply to confirm.

## Cancelling
If payment has not been confirmed yet, we can usually cancel without issue. If you paid, refunds follow our [refund policy](/refunds/), which includes a restocking fee in some cases and applies within 30 days of purchase.

## Changing payment method
Switching between methods is simplest before we send payment details or before you pay. Contact us first so you do not pay twice.

## Fix an address
Tell us the corrected address in writing and wait for confirmation. Note that delivery needs an adult signature at that address.

## Avoiding issues
Double-check your cart and address before submitting. Review your confirmation email immediately and read [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

title: What to Do If Your Package Is Delayed
summary: Late parcels happen. Follow this checklist to find out where yours is and when to contact us for help.
body:
If your order has not arrived when you expected, work through these steps.

## 1. Check the timeline
Add our processing time (24 to 72 business hours) to the carrier transit estimate for your region. Weekends and federal holidays do not count. West Coast deliveries take about 3 to 7 business days in transit, and the eastern half of the US about 11 to 18. See [shipping times](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## 2. Look at tracking
Open your tracking email or the order page. Updates can pause for several days in regional carrier networks. See [how to track your order](/blog/how-to-track-your-order/).

## 3. Look for a delivery notice
Because an adult must sign, carriers often leave a note after a missed attempt. Check your door, mailbox and phone.

## 4. Confirm your address
Make sure the address on your order is correct, including apartment numbers.

## 5. Contact the carrier
If tracking shows delivered but you do not have it, call the carrier with your tracking number.

## 6. Contact us
If the estimated window has passed, email or WhatsApp us with your order ID. Business contact options are on the [contact page](/contact/).

## Returned packages
If a carrier returns an undelivered package, a refund is available minus the restocking fee and shipping cost, per the [shipping policy](/shipping/).

## Lost or damaged
For damage see [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: When should I worry?
faq.a: If tracking has not moved well beyond the estimated window, contact us.

faq.q: Do you reship lost packages?
faq.a: Our shipping policy explains what is covered. Contact us with your order ID to review your case.

title: Our Refund and Return Policy Explained in Plain English
summary: Returns are accepted within 30 days with some restrictions and a restocking fee. Here is what qualifies, what does not and how to start.
body:
This article summarizes our [refund policy](/refunds/). If anything here differs from the policy page, the policy page applies.

## The 30-day window
Returns and exchanges must be requested within 30 days of the purchase date.

## How to start
Contact us before sending anything back so we can issue an RMA form. Returns without an RMA cannot be guaranteed a refund or exchange. Use the [contact page](/contact/) to begin.

## What a refund includes
After we receive the product, we issue a refund minus a 15% restocking fee. Shipping fees are not refunded, and you are responsible for return shipping. We do not provide prepaid return labels and recommend adding insurance.

## Exchanges
We are happy to exchange within 30 days. A team member will call to confirm what you want, and you pay only the difference if the new items cost more.

## What we cannot accept
- Opened or used e-liquid.
- Opened or used devices and accessories.
- Items not bought from our store.
- Partially returned sample packs and bundle deals.
- Puffco products, which do not qualify for refunds or exchanges.
These limits exist because of FDA regulation and hygiene.

## Returned by the carrier
If a carrier returns an undelivered package, refund rules in the [shipping policy](/shipping/) apply.

## Tips
Photograph items before sending and keep the tracking number. For damaged goods use [this guide](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is there a restocking fee?
faq.a: Yes, 15% on refunds, as described in the refund policy.

faq.q: Can I return an opened device?
faq.a: No. Opened or used devices and e-liquid cannot be returned.

title: Shipping Address Tips: Avoid Missed and Returned Deliveries
summary: A good address and a plan for signature prevent most delivery problems. Use these tips for apartments, workplaces and gated buildings.
body:
Most delivery problems come from address details or no one being available to sign. These tips help.

## Use the exact address
Include apartment, suite or unit numbers in the second address line, and your full ZIP code. Mismatches cause delays and returns.

## Choose a place where an adult will be
Every package needs an adult 21 or older to sign with photo ID. A home address where someone is present, or a workplace that allows personal deliveries, usually works best. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Gated communities and apartment buildings
Add gate codes, buzzer numbers and building notes in the order notes. Tell your building staff to expect a delivery that needs a signature.

## Avoid P.O. boxes
Carriers cannot obtain a signature at a P.O. box. Use a street address.

## Name on the package
Use the name on your ID. Some carriers require the recipient's name to match.

## Where we do not ship
Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the U.S. Virgin Islands and military addresses are excluded from free shipping, and we do not ship internationally. See [where we ship](/blog/where-we-ship-and-where-we-do-not/).

## After you order
Watch for the tracking email. If you will be away, tell us right away through the [contact page](/contact/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I ship to a friend?

title: The PACT Act Explained for Vape Buyers
summary: The PACT Act changed how vape products are shipped, taxed and delivered. Here is a plain summary of what it means for online buyers.
body:
The Prevent All Cigarette Trafficking (PACT) Act was amended by legislation signed in December 2020. Its provisions covering e-cigarettes and vaping products took effect on March 27, 2021. This article is general information, not legal advice. Laws change and differ by state and city, so check the rules where you live.

## What it covers
The law treats vaping products similarly to cigarettes for remote sales. That includes how they are shipped, taxed and delivered.

## Shipping limits
The U.S. Postal Service may not carry vaping products, so sellers use other carriers. Some carriers have also limited what they accept, which can lead to interruptions in some areas.

## Adult signature
Every delivery must be signed for by an adult aged 21 or older with ID. See [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/).

## Labeling
Parcels must carry a label stating that federal law requires payment of applicable excise taxes and compliance with licensing and tax-stamping obligations.

## Taxes and licensing
Sellers must register and comply with state and local licensing and tax rules. Some states tax vape products and sellers may collect those taxes. See [vape taxes overview](/blog/vape-taxes-by-state-overview/).

## What it means for you
You may see delivery rules and restrictions that did not exist for older orders. Our own summary is on the [PACT Act FAQ](/pact-act/) page, and details on shipping are in the [shipping policy](/shipping/).

## Not legal advice
Rules change, so confirm requirements with official sources. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.a: Remote sales are allowed under federal law when sellers comply with the PACT Act and with state and local rules.

title: The FDA and Vaping Products: What Adult Buyers Should Know
summary: The FDA regulates e-cigarettes as tobacco products. Learn what marketing authorization means and why you should check product and local rules.
body:
In the United States, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulates e-cigarettes and other electronic nicotine delivery systems as tobacco products. This article is general information, not legal advice. Laws change and differ by state and city, so check the rules where you live.

## Marketing authorization
New tobacco products generally need FDA marketing authorization before they can be legally sold. Only some vaping products have received it. Many products on the market have not, and enforcement actions against unauthorized products can change what retailers may sell.

## What this means for buyers
Availability can change quickly. Products you could buy last year may become restricted, and some states restrict sales to authorized products only. Check your local rules before you order.

## Warning statements
Packaging must carry the FDA nicotine warning: "WARNING: This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is an addictive chemical." See [what the warning means](/blog/what-the-nicotine-warning-label-means/).

## No health claims
We make no health or regulatory-endorsement claims about any product, and you should be cautious of any seller that does.

## Our disclaimer
Our [FDA disclaimer](/fda-disclaimer/) page explains our position in detail. If you have questions about a specific product, ask us via the [contact page](/contact/).

## How to stay informed
Visit the FDA's tobacco products pages and your state's regulator for current lists and rules. Also read [state and local vape laws explained](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Browse responsibly
Adults 21+ only. See [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) when you are ready.

faq.q: Does FDA regulation mean a product is approved?
faq.a: No. Regulation is not an endorsement, and authorization applies only to specific products that received it.

faq.q: Where can I check the status?
faq.a: The FDA publishes information on authorized tobacco products on its website.

title: Vape Taxes by State: A Plain Overview
summary: Many states tax vaping products, using different methods and rates. Here is how those taxes generally work and why they affect online orders.
body:
If your state taxes vaping products, it can change what you pay. This article is general information, not legal advice. Laws change and differ by state and city, so check the rules where you live.

## Why states tax vapes
Many states levy excise taxes on e-cigarettes and e-liquids, similar to those on cigarettes. The goal is often revenue and discouraging use.

## How taxes are calculated
Methods differ:
- **Percentage of price:** a share of the wholesale or retail price.
- **Per milliliter:** a fixed amount per mL of liquid.
- **Per device or per cartridge:** a flat amount per item.
- **Mixed systems:** a combination.

## Online sales and the PACT Act
Under the PACT Act, remote sellers must comply with state tax requirements, and in some cases collect and remit them. See the [PACT Act overview](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/).

## Seeing it on your order
Where applicable, taxes are itemized in your order total. Free-shipping thresholds are measured before tax. See [minimum order and free shipping](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).

## Where to get exact numbers
Rates change often. Check your state's department of revenue or taxation website for current rules.

## Impact on prices
Tax can raise the cost of a vape noticeably in some states. Compare overall costs with [cost per puff](/blog/how-to-compare-vape-prices-per-puff/).

## Questions
Contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your state and we will explain how it appears on your order. Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.a: Not usually. Where applicable it is added and itemized.

title: Traveling With Vapes: Airline and Battery Rules in Brief
summary: Vapes belong in carry-on bags, never checked luggage, and cannot be used on board. Learn the basics before your next trip.
body:
If you are flying with a vape, a few rules apply almost everywhere. This article is general information, not legal advice. Laws change and differ by state and city, so check the rules where you live.

## Carry-on only
Under U.S. aviation rules, e-cigarettes, vaporizers and spare lithium batteries must travel in carry-on baggage. They are not allowed in checked bags, because battery fires are easier to handle in the cabin.

## No vaping on board
Using a vape on a commercial aircraft, including in the lavatory, is prohibited.

## Protect batteries
Keep spare batteries in a case or separate pouches so metal objects cannot touch the terminals. Switch off devices, lock the fire button if it has one and store them where they cannot be pressed accidentally.

## Liquids
Liquids follow the standard carry-on liquid rules: containers of 3.4 ounces or less in a clear bag. Pressure changes can cause leaks, so keep pods nearly empty and sealed. See [choosing a vape for travel](/blog/best-vapes-for-travel/).

## At your destination
Rules differ by state, city and country. Some places ban vape use in public or even possession. Read [state and local vape laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## International travel
Many countries restrict or ban vapes and nicotine liquids. Check the laws and customs rules before you go.

## Related
Check [battery care basics](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/). Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I put my vape in checked luggage?
faq.a: No. Vapes and spare lithium batteries belong in carry-on bags.

faq.q: Can I vape in an airport?
faq.a: Only where it is allowed. Many airports restrict it to certain areas or ban it entirely.

title: Lithium Battery Care Basics for Vape Devices
summary: Most vapes use lithium-ion batteries. Follow these care basics to protect the device, avoid damage and extend battery life.
body:
Almost every rechargeable vape uses a lithium-ion battery. Treat it with the same care as a phone or power bank.

## Use the right charger
Charge with the cable supplied or a reputable one, from a standard USB port or wall adapter. Cheap, unbranded chargers can supply inconsistent power.

## Do not leave it charging unattended
Charge on a hard, flat, non-flammable surface and avoid sleeping with a charging device by your bed.

## Avoid heat and cold
Do not leave a vape in a hot car or direct sun, and avoid freezing temperatures. Heat shortens battery life and can damage the device.

## Do not use a damaged device
Stop using any device that is swollen, dented, hot to touch, leaking or has damaged wiring. Dispose of it properly; see [how to dispose of vapes and batteries](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Pocket and bag habits
Keep devices separate from coins and keys, which can short the battery terminals. Use a case if possible.

## Replaceable batteries
Box mods that use removable cells need correctly rated batteries. Never mix brands, ages or charge levels, and use cells with wraps in good condition.

## Charging habits
Charge before the device is completely empty when you can, and unplug once it is full. See [extending battery life](/blog/how-to-extend-vape-battery-life/) and [charging a disposable](/blog/how-to-charge-a-disposable/).

## Where to shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I use a phone fast charger?
faq.a: Many devices tolerate it, but check the manual. If unsure, use a standard 5V adapter.

faq.q: How long do vape batteries last?
faq.a: Built-in batteries typically last for hundreds of charge cycles, depending on use and care.

title: How to Dispose of Vapes, Pods and Batteries Responsibly
summary: Vapes contain batteries, electronics and residual nicotine. Here is how to dispose of them properly and where to look for recycling options.
body:
A used vape is not ordinary trash. It contains a lithium battery, electronics, plastics and residual liquid containing nicotine.

## Why it matters
Lithium batteries can start fires in garbage trucks and recycling plants when crushed. Nicotine liquid is hazardous to children, pets and the environment if it leaks.

## Do not put them in household trash or curbside recycling
Many municipalities treat vapes as electronic or hazardous waste. Check your local rules.

## Where to take them
- **Household hazardous waste sites** and collection events.
- **Electronics recycling programs** that accept small electronics.
- **Battery drop-off locations** at some retailers, which may accept lithium batteries.
Search for your city's hazardous waste page or use a recycling locator.

## Before you drop it off
Stop using any damaged or swollen device. Put it in a sealed plastic bag, tape over battery terminals if exposed, and keep it away from heat. Do not try to open or crush it.

## Liquids
Do not pour leftover liquid down the drain. Absorb small amounts with cat litter or paper towels, seal in a bag and take it to hazardous waste, following local guidance.

## Pods and coils
Used pods and coils go in the same stream as the device, unless your local program says otherwise.

## Related
Learn about [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/) and [keeping vapes away from children and pets](/blog/keeping-vapes-away-from-children-and-pets/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Can I throw a dead disposable in the trash?
faq.a: Check local rules. Most areas ask you to treat it as electronic or hazardous waste because of the lithium battery.

faq.q: Does a dead vape still contain nicotine?
faq.a: It may contain residual liquid, so keep it away from children and pets until disposed of.

title: Keeping Vapes and E-Liquid Away From Children and Pets
summary: Nicotine liquid and devices must be kept out of reach. Here is how adults can store them responsibly and what to do if there is a spill.
body:
E-liquid contains nicotine, and a small amount can be dangerous to children and pets. Responsible storage is part of being an adult user.

## Store out of reach and out of sight
Keep liquids, pods and devices in a high, closed cabinet or a lockable box. Do not leave them on tables, in handbags or in cars.

## Keep original packaging
Child-resistant caps and warning labels are on the packaging for a reason. Do not decant liquid into unlabelled or food-style containers.

## Do not use food-style containers
Brightly colored or fruit-flavored liquid can attract attention. Never store it in drink bottles or near snacks.

## Handle spills promptly
Wipe spills with paper towels while wearing gloves, wash the surface and your hands, and dispose of the towels responsibly. Avoid skin contact.

## If someone is exposed
Contact Poison Control right away at 1-800-222-1222 in the U.S., or your local emergency number. Do not wait for symptoms.

## Dispose responsibly
Used devices and empty pods are also hazardous. See [how to dispose of vapes](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

## Everyday habits
Charge devices where children cannot reach them, and never let anyone under 21 handle a vape. Read about [age verification](/blog/what-21-plus-age-verification-means/) and [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Browse
See [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is vape liquid dangerous if swallowed?
faq.a: Yes. Nicotine liquid can be harmful if swallowed or absorbed through skin, so seek help immediately.

faq.q: Who do I call?
faq.a: Poison Control in the U.S. at 1-800-222-1222, or emergency services in an emergency.

title: What the Nicotine Warning Label Means
summary: Every nicotine product carries a warning. Here is what the statement says, why it is required and how to read it as an adult consumer.
body:
Look at any vape, e-liquid or pouch sold in the United States and you will find a warning: "WARNING: This product contains nicotine. Nicotine is an addictive chemical." This article is general information, not legal advice. Laws change and differ by state and city, so check the rules where you live.

## Why the warning exists
The FDA requires it on the packaging and in advertisements for nicotine products. It reminds adults that nicotine is addictive.

## What it tells you
Nicotine is a stimulant that the body can become dependent on. Using a product that contains it can lead to cravings and dependence, which is why products are limited to adults aged 21 and over.

## Where to find it
On the front or side panel of the package, often in a bordered box. If a product has no warning, treat it with caution and do not buy it.

## What it does not say
It does not describe a product as more or less harmful than any other. We do not make health comparisons, and neither should sellers.

## Other warnings
You may see notes for pregnant or nursing women, people with health conditions and children and pets. Follow them. Nothing here is medical advice; consult a healthcare professional with questions.

title: How Does a Vape Work? Battery, Coil, Wick and Liquid
summary: A vape is a battery that heats a coil to turn liquid into vapor. Here is how each part works together in plain language.
body:
Every vape, from a tiny disposable to a large box mod, works on the same basic principle: a battery powers a small heater that turns liquid into an inhalable vapor.

## The four key parts
- **Battery:** supplies power to the heater.
- **Coil:** a small heating element, made from wire or mesh.
- **Wick:** usually cotton, it soaks up liquid and holds it against the coil.
- **E-liquid:** a mixture of propylene glycol, vegetable glycerin, flavoring and usually nicotine.

## What happens when you inhale
When you draw on the mouthpiece, an airflow sensor detects the change and sends power to the coil, or you press a button. The coil heats up in a fraction of a second. The liquid in the wick vaporizes, and the vapor travels through the airflow path to your mouth.

## Why liquid and airflow must balance
If the wick is dry, the coil can scorch the cotton and taste burnt. If there is too much liquid, it can flood and gurgle. See [fixing gurgling](/blog/vape-gurgling-sound-fix/) and [a burnt taste](/blog/vape-tastes-burnt/).

## Device types
Disposables are sealed units; pods have a replaceable pod; box mods use tanks with replaceable coils. Compare them in [disposable vs pod vs box mod](/blog/disposable-vs-pod-vs-box-mod/).

## Nicotine and flavor
Nicotine strength and type are set by the liquid, while flavor comes from the recipe. Learn about [PG and VG](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/).

## Safety reminder
Nicotine is addictive and these products are for adults 21+. See [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) for starter hardware.

faq.q: Is vapor the same as smoke?
faq.a: No. Vapor is created by heating liquid, not by burning plant material. We make no health claims either way.

faq.q: Why does a coil need to be primed?

title: Parts of a Vape: A Labeled Guide for Beginners
summary: Mouthpiece, tank, pod, coil, wick, battery and more. Learn what each component does so you can shop and troubleshoot with confidence.
body:
A quick tour of the pieces you will hear about when you shop for vape hardware.

## Mouthpiece (drip tip)
The part you draw from. Some are interchangeable on tanks, while on disposables they are fixed.

## Tank or pod
Holds the e-liquid. Tanks are larger and refilled through a fill port. Pods are compact cartridges that snap into the battery. See [what a pod vape is](/blog/what-is-a-pod-vape-and-how-to-choose/).

## Coil
The heating element, usually mesh or wire. It wears out and needs replacing. Learn [mesh versus standard coils](/blog/dual-mesh-vs-single-mesh-coils/).

## Wick
Cotton inside the coil that carries liquid to the heating surface.

## Battery
Powers the heater. Capacity is measured in mAh. See [battery basics](/blog/mah-puffs-and-battery-life-how-they-relate/).

## Airflow control
A ring or slider that adjusts air intake. See [adjustable airflow](/blog/adjustable-airflow-explained/).

## 510 connector
A standard threaded connection that lets many tanks fit many mods.

## Charging port
Modern devices use USB-C. Older devices use micro-USB or proprietary connectors.

## Fire button and sensor
Devices fire on inhale (auto-draw) or when you press a button.

## Shopping
Match replacement parts to your exact device. Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/) and [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: What is a 510 connector?
faq.a: A standard thread that attaches many tanks and atomizers to compatible batteries.

faq.q: Are all coils interchangeable?
faq.a: No. They are designed for specific tanks and pods.

title: Vape Glossary: Common Terms Every Shopper Should Know
summary: Understand the jargon on product pages, from MTL and DTL to mAh, ohm, shortfill and nic salts, all in one quick reference.
body:
Product pages use a lot of shorthand. Here are the terms you will meet most often.

## Device terms
- **Disposable:** a pre-filled, ready-to-use device. See [how to choose one](/blog/how-to-choose-a-disposable-vape/).
- **Pod:** a compact, replaceable liquid cartridge.
- **Mod:** a battery unit, often with adjustable power.
- **Tank:** a refillable container with a coil.

## Electrical terms
- **mAh:** battery capacity, in milliamp hours.
- **Ohm (Ω):** coil resistance.
- **Watt (W):** power delivered to the coil.

## Style terms
- **MTL:** mouth-to-lung inhale.
- **DTL / sub-ohm:** direct-to-lung inhale with a low-resistance coil. See [the difference](/blog/sub-ohm-vs-mouth-to-lung/).

## Liquid terms
- **PG / VG:** propylene glycol and vegetable glycerin, the liquid base. See [PG and VG](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/).
- **Nic salts:** a smoother type of nicotine for low-power devices.
- **Freebase:** the traditional form of nicotine.
- **Shortfill:** a bottle with spare room for nicotine shots.
- **Steeping:** letting liquid rest so flavors blend.

## Experience terms
- **Throat hit:** the sensation of vapor on the throat.
- **Ghosting:** a lingering flavor from a previous liquid.
- **Dry hit:** a harsh, burnt draw from a dry wick.

## Brand terms
- **Puffs:** the estimated number of draws; see [puff counts explained](/blog/puff-count-explained/).

## Shop
Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: What does MTL mean?
faq.a: Mouth-to-lung, a draw style where vapor is held in the mouth before inhaling.

faq.q: What is ghosting?
faq.a: Flavor from a previous liquid lingering in the coil or wick.

title: mAh, Puffs and Battery Life: How They Relate
summary: A bigger battery does not always mean more puffs. See how mAh, power mode and coil design combine to decide how long a vape lasts.
body:
Battery capacity, measured in milliamp hours (mAh), is just one factor in how long a vape runs. Here is how the pieces fit.

## What mAh tells you
mAh measures how much charge a battery holds. A 1,000 mAh battery holds twice the charge of a 500 mAh one, all else equal.

## Power use matters
A device that runs at low power uses less energy per puff than a high-wattage one. Boost modes drain the battery faster. So a smaller battery on an efficient device can last as long as a bigger one on a power-hungry device.

## Puff counts and batteries
Puff counts on disposables are set mostly by liquid volume, with the battery sized to match. See [puff counts explained](/blog/puff-count-explained/). Rechargeable models can add extra puffs by charging.

## Real-world factors
- Draw length and frequency.
- Temperature: batteries lose capacity when cold.
- Age: capacity falls after many cycles.
- Coil resistance.

## Reading product pages
Look for mAh and for any mention of USB-C charging or pass-through. Our [rechargeable versus non-rechargeable article](/blog/rechargeable-vs-non-rechargeable-disposables/) shows what to check.

## Looking after it
Care extends life: see [battery care basics](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/) and [extending battery life](/blog/how-to-extend-vape-battery-life/).

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is more mAh always better?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Capacity helps, but efficiency and usage patterns matter too.

faq.q: Why does my battery die faster in winter?
faq.a: Cold temperatures reduce a lithium battery's effective capacity.

title: What Is a Mesh Coil, and Why Do So Many Vapes Use One?
summary: Mesh coils use a thin metal sheet instead of a wire wrap. Learn how that changes heating, flavor and why it became popular.
body:
If you have shopped for vapes recently, you have seen "mesh coil" on almost every listing. Here is what it means.

## From wire to mesh
Traditional coils wrap a wire around a cotton wick. A mesh coil replaces the wire with a thin sheet of woven or perforated metal that lines the wick.

## Why it heats differently
A mesh sheet has a large surface area touching the cotton. That means liquid is heated across a wide area rather than in a few hot spots. The result is quicker heating and more even vaporization.

## What users notice
- Smoother, fuller flavor.
- Consistent vapor from puff to puff.
- Less chance of local scorching.

## Coils in disposables
Most modern disposables use mesh coils to deliver consistent flavor for thousands of puffs. Dual-mesh designs double down on this. See [mesh versus standard coils](/blog/dual-mesh-vs-single-mesh-coils/).

## Drawbacks
Mesh coils can cost more to make and can be affected by thick or sweet liquids, which leave residue. Using the recommended liquid and power helps.

## Replacing them
Mesh coils still wear out. See [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/) and [picking replacements](/blog/how-to-pick-replacement-coils-and-pods/).

## Shop
Browse [coils and pods](/shop/coils-pods/). Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Is mesh better than wire?
faq.a: Mesh tends to give smoother flavor and heating, but a well-made wire coil can also perform well.

faq.q: Do mesh coils need priming?
faq.a: Yes. Let them soak before the first puff to avoid scorching.

title: Ohms, Watts and Volts in Vaping: A Beginner's Explanation
summary: Resistance, power and voltage control how a coil performs. This guide explains them without the math headache.
body:
You do not need an engineering degree, but a little electrical knowledge helps you choose hardware and settings.

## Ohms: resistance
Ohms (Ω) measure how much a coil resists current. Low-resistance coils draw more current and heat faster. High-resistance coils heat more gently.

## Watts: power
Watts (W) measure the power the device sends to the coil. More watts means more heat, more vapor and faster liquid use. Every coil has a recommended wattage range, and staying within it protects both flavor and lifespan.

## Volts: electrical pressure
Volts (V) describe the electrical pressure. Some devices let you set voltage rather than watts.

## How they relate
Power equals voltage squared divided by resistance. In practice, you pick a coil with a resistance suited to your style and set the wattage within its range.

## Typical ranges
- **MTL coils:** about 1 ohm or higher, at lower wattage.
- **Sub-ohm coils:** below 1 ohm, at higher wattage.
See [sub-ohm versus mouth-to-lung](/blog/sub-ohm-vs-mouth-to-lung/).

## Start low
Begin at the lower end of the recommended range and increase gradually. If the vapor tastes harsh or burnt, lower the power.

## Care
Use the right battery for high-power setups; see [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/). Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: What wattage should I use?
faq.a: Use the range printed on the coil, starting near the bottom.

faq.q: Do disposables have adjustable wattage?
faq.a: Almost never. Power is set by the manufacturer, sometimes with a boost mode.

title: What Is in E-Liquid? PG, VG, Flavoring and Nicotine Explained
summary: E-liquid has four main components. Learn what each one does, what to look for on a label and what is meant by food-grade flavoring.
body:
E-liquid is a short list of ingredients, though the details differ between brands.

## Propylene glycol (PG)
A thin, odorless liquid that carries flavor and gives throat feel. It is used widely in food and personal care products.

## Vegetable glycerin (VG)
A thicker, slightly sweet liquid made from plant oils, which produces denser vapor.

## Flavoring
Flavor concentrates give each liquid its character. Brands describe them as food-grade, meaning they are commonly used in foods, though being edible is not the same as being suitable to inhale. We make no health claims about flavorings.

## Nicotine
Present in most liquids, as freebase or nicotine salts, in a stated strength. Nicotine is addictive. See the [nicotine strength guide](/blog/nicotine-strength-guide/).

## Optional extras
Some liquids add cooling agents, sweeteners or water. Not all are listed in detail, so check the brand's information.

## Reading the label
Look for ratios, strength, volume and the warning statement. Our guide to [reading an e-liquid label](/blog/how-to-read-an-e-liquid-label/) walks through each element.

## Storage
Keep liquid cool, dark and away from children and pets; see [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Allergies
If you suspect a reaction to an ingredient, stop using the product and talk to a healthcare professional.

## Shop
Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Are all e-liquids made the same way?
faq.a: They share a base of PG and VG, but flavor systems and extras differ between brands.

faq.q: Is PG or VG an allergen?
faq.a: Some people are sensitive to them. If you notice irritation, stop using the product.

title: What Is Steeping, and Does It Matter for E-Liquid?
summary: Steeping lets flavors blend over days or weeks. Learn when it helps, when it does not and how to do it properly.
body:
Steeping is the practice of letting e-liquid rest, usually in a cool dark place, so flavors blend and mellow.

## Why people steep
Fresh mixed liquid can taste sharp or uneven. Over time, flavor molecules disperse and the nicotine mellows, which can make the liquid taste rounder.

## Which liquids benefit
- **Dessert and custard recipes** often improve with a week or two.
- **Tobacco flavors** often benefit from longer.
- **Fruit and menthol** recipes usually taste good fresh and need less.

## Do commercial liquids need it
Most commercial liquids are ready to use, and many brands steep before bottling. A few extra days rarely hurts, but it is not required.

## How to steep
1. Cap the bottle tightly.
2. Shake it, then open the cap briefly to release air.
3. Store it in a cool, dark place away from direct sunlight.
4. Shake occasionally and wait several days.

## What to avoid
Do not store liquid in a hot car or window sill, and do not leave caps loose. Heat and light can darken liquid and change flavor. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Dark color is normal
Nicotine liquid darkens with time and oxygen. A little color change is usual.

## Shop
Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/), or read about [bottle sizes](/blog/e-liquid-bottle-sizes-30ml-60ml-100ml/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: How long should I steep?
faq.a: Many liquids are fine immediately. Dessert and tobacco profiles often taste better after a week or two.

faq.q: Does steeping change nicotine strength?
faq.a: No. It changes how the liquid tastes and feels, not its labeled strength.

title: What Is Throat Hit, and What Affects It?
summary: Throat hit is the sensation vapor creates in your throat. See what increases or softens it, from nicotine type to PG ratio and temperature.
body:
Throat hit is the feeling of vapor at the back of the throat when you inhale. It is a major part of why people choose certain liquids and devices.

## What creates it
- **Nicotine strength:** higher strength gives a stronger sensation.
- **Nicotine type:** freebase feels sharper; salts feel smoother. See [salts versus freebase](/blog/nicotine-salts-vs-freebase/).
- **PG content:** high-PG liquids feel crisper than high-VG ones.
- **Temperature:** hotter vapor feels harsher.
- **Airflow:** tighter airflow concentrates the sensation.

## Cooling agents
Menthol-type cooling can add a sensation distinct from nicotine throat hit. Read about [ice flavors](/blog/ice-vape-flavors-guide/).

## How to soften it
- Lower the strength.
- Choose a higher-VG liquid.
- Open the airflow or lower the wattage.
- Try nicotine salts if you want a smooth feel at higher strength.

## How to increase it
Choose a higher PG ratio, tighter airflow or a slightly higher strength, within what is comfortable. Nicotine is addictive, and increasing intake is not advisable for everyone.

## Everyone is different
There is no right level. Experiment sensibly and stop if you feel unwell.

## Related
See [PG and VG](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/) and [adjustable airflow](/blog/adjustable-airflow-explained/). Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is stronger throat hit better?
faq.a: It is a preference, not a measure of quality.

faq.q: Why do salts feel smooth at high strength?
faq.a: The acid in the salt changes how nicotine is delivered, which softens the sensation.

title: How Cooling 'Ice' Flavors Work (and Who Likes Them)
summary: Ice versions add a chill to fruit and candy flavors. Learn what creates the sensation, how strong it can be and how to pick the right level.
body:
Many flavor names include "ice", "freeze" or "chill". These versions add a cooling sensation to the original flavor.

## What creates the cooling
Cooling comes from compounds that trigger the cold-sensing receptors in your mouth and throat, similar to the effect of mint. They do not change the temperature of the vapor; they change how it feels.

## Levels of cooling
Some recipes add a light cool finish, while others are a strong, icy blast. Names like "extra ice" usually signal more.

## Why people like it
Cooling can brighten fruit flavors and make sweeter profiles feel fresher. Some find it also softens the heat of vapor.

## Who may prefer no ice
If you are sensitive to menthol or find cooling harsh, choose a non-ice version. Our [ice flavors guide](/blog/ice-vape-flavors-guide/) lists options.

## How to compare
Try the same flavor with and without ice to learn your preference. Rotating can also keep flavors interesting; see [best disposables for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/).

## Impact on hardware
Cooling agents can leave residue on coils over time. Keep to the recommended power and replace parts on schedule; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Does ice mean menthol?
faq.a: Often it means a menthol-type cooling agent, though recipes vary.

faq.q: Can I get a cooling flavor without mint?
faq.a: Yes. Many fruit-and-ice flavors use cooling without a strong mint taste.

title: A Short History of Vaping: From Early Patents to Pod Systems
summary: Electronic cigarettes have evolved over decades, from early patents to cig-a-likes, tanks, box mods and today's pods and disposables.
body:
Modern vaping has a surprisingly long backstory. Here is a short timeline of how devices developed.

## Early ideas
Patents for smokeless electronic devices appeared in the 1960s, but the concept did not reach consumers at the time.

## The first commercial e-cigarette
In 2003, a Chinese pharmacist named Hon Lik designed a modern electronic cigarette that used an ultrasonic atomizer. Commercial products reached the market in the mid-2000s and spread to Europe and the United States.

## Cig-a-likes
First-generation devices looked like cigarettes and used small batteries and cartomizers. They were simple but limited in battery life and vapor.

## Tanks and box mods
Around 2010, refillable tanks and larger battery devices let users customize power, airflow and flavor. Sub-ohm vaping emerged, producing larger vapor clouds.

## The pod era
Compact, easy pod systems appeared in the mid-2010s, using nicotine salts to deliver smoother, stronger hits from low-power hardware.

## Disposables
Pre-filled disposables grew in popularity because they need no setup. Recent models include mesh coils, rechargeable batteries and screens. See [how to choose a disposable](/blog/how-to-choose-a-disposable-vape/).

## Regulation
Governments have steadily regulated vaping, from age limits to the [PACT Act](/blog/pact-act-explained-for-vape-buyers/) and FDA oversight. See [FDA and vaping products](/blog/fda-and-vaping-products-what-adults-should-know/).

## Today
Hardware is more compact and easier than ever. Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) to see current options. Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Who invented the modern e-cigarette?
faq.a: Hon Lik, a Chinese pharmacist, designed a modern electronic cigarette in 2003.

faq.q: Why did pods become popular?
faq.a: They are small, simple and work well with nicotine salts.

title: Vapes, Pouches and Other Nicotine Products: How They Differ
summary: A neutral comparison of how vapes and nicotine pouches work, what each requires and what adults should consider before using them.
body:
Nicotine products come in several forms. This overview describes how they differ in use, without health claims or recommendations.

## Vapes
A vape heats liquid to create vapor that you inhale. They need a charged battery, and refillable ones need liquid and coils. See [how a vape works](/blog/how-does-a-vape-work/).

## Nicotine pouches
Pouches are small tobacco-free pouches placed between the lip and gum. Nicotine is absorbed in the mouth, and there is no vapor, device or charging. See [pouches for beginners](/blog/nicotine-pouches-beginners-guide/).

## Practical differences
- **Equipment:** vapes need hardware; pouches need none.
- **Discretion:** pouches produce no vapor.
- **Cost:** vary by brand and use.
- **Rules:** laws for vaping and pouches differ by place.

## What they have in common
All contain nicotine, which is addictive, and are for adults 21 and over. None come without risks, and we make no health claims.

## Choosing
Think about where you will use it, how much effort you want to spend and local rules. Many adults try one form and stay with it.

## Browse
See [nicotine pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Read [state and local vape laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Not medical advice
If you want advice on nicotine use, consult a healthcare professional. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Do pouches contain tobacco?
faq.a: Modern pouches are described as tobacco-free, though they contain nicotine.

faq.q: Which one is right for me?
faq.a: That depends on your preferences and local rules. Neither comes without risk.

title: What Is a Box Mod? Features, Benefits and Who Needs One
summary: Box mods are larger, adjustable devices for experienced users. Learn what they offer over pods and what to know before buying one.
body:
A box mod is a battery-powered device that holds one or more batteries and powers a separate tank. They are the larger, more adjustable end of vape hardware.

## What makes them different
Box mods offer adjustable wattage, temperature or voltage settings, bigger batteries and compatibility with many tanks via a 510 thread. Many include a screen and menu.

## Benefits
- **Power range:** support for sub-ohm tanks and big vapor.
- **Battery life:** larger cells last longer.
- **Customization:** swap tanks and coils to suit your taste.

## Drawbacks
- **Size and weight:** bulkier than pods.
- **Complexity:** more settings and more to learn.
- **Safety considerations:** removable batteries need correct handling. See [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## Who should consider one
Experienced adult vapers who want to tune their device and use high-power tanks. Beginners are usually better served by pods; see [disposable vs pod vs box mod](/blog/disposable-vs-pod-vs-box-mod/).

## Coils and liquid
Pair a box mod with a sub-ohm tank and a lower-strength, higher-VG liquid. See [PG and VG ratios](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/) and [ohms, watts and volts](/blog/what-are-ohms-watts-and-volts-in-vaping/).

## Shop
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/). Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Do box mods need special batteries?
faq.a: Many use removable 18650 or 21700 cells. Use cells rated for the device and never mix them.

faq.q: Can a beginner use a box mod?
faq.a: Possible, but a simpler pod kit is usually easier to start with.

title: E-Liquid Shelf Life: How Long Does It Last?
summary: Unopened e-liquid usually lasts a year or two when stored well. See what shortens shelf life and how to tell when liquid has gone off.
body:
E-liquid does not last forever, but with good storage it stays usable for a long time.

## Typical shelf life
Most bottles carry a best-by date about one to two years after manufacture. Unopened liquid stored properly generally stays fine until then.

## What shortens it
- **Heat:** warm places accelerate chemical changes.
- **Light:** sunlight darkens liquid and degrades flavor.
- **Air:** every opening introduces oxygen. Keep caps tight.
- **Contamination:** dirty tips or fingers.

## Signs of aging
Liquid darkens, flavor weakens, or it smells or tastes off. Darkening alone is usual with nicotine, but a sour or flat taste means it is past its best.

## Nicotine and flavor
Nicotine slowly oxidizes, which changes color. Flavors, especially delicate fruits, can fade over time.

## How to extend life
Store in a cool, dark place, such as a drawer. Keep it upright, and tighten the cap after use. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/).

## Buying in bulk
Only buy more than you will use before the date. See [bottle sizes](/blog/e-liquid-bottle-sizes-30ml-60ml-100ml/).

## What to do with old liquid
Dispose of expired or off-tasting liquid responsibly; see [disposal guidance](/blog/how-to-dispose-of-vapes-and-batteries/).

title: Cloud Chasing vs Flavor Chasing: Two Ways to Vape
summary: Some adults want big vapor, others want the best taste. Compare the hardware and settings for each style.
body:
Vapers tend to favor either large vapor clouds or concentrated flavor. The hardware and settings differ for each. We currently list **75 products** with clouds in the name across 1 categories at One Stop Vape Store. This guide explains what clouds tastes like in vapes, how it is usually blended, where to find it, which brands make it and how to choose the right product, using the live catalog so the numbers match the shop.

## What clouds tastes like in a vape
Vapers tend to favor either large vapor clouds or concentrated flavor. The hardware and settings differ for each. Most flavors are blended with a supporting note: a cooling finish for freshness, a sweet fruit for balance or a creamy base for body. Flavor is personal, so treat any description as a guide: the same recipe can taste sweeter, sharper or fuller depending on the device, how you draw and what you vaped before.

If you are choosing clouds for the first time, try one product from a brand you already trust before stocking up, and compare two or three variations (plain, iced and blended) so you learn which style you prefer. Our [vape flavor profiles guide](/blog/vape-flavor-profiles-explained/) explains how the main flavor families work, and [best disposable vapes for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/) is a good next read.

## How clouds is blended
Reading the product names in our catalog, clouds is most often combined with berry, cooling and ice, orchard and stone fruit, citrus and tropical notes:

- **Berry:** 31 products. Berry flavors balance sweetness and tartness. Blue raspberry, strawberry and mixed-berry blends are among the most reliable crowd-pleasers in vaping.
- **Cooling And Ice:** 23 products. Cooling flavors add a crisp, chilled edge. Instead of changing the fruit or dessert at the core of a recipe, they sharpen it, which is why so many fruit flavors ship in an “ice” version.
- **Orchard And Stone Fruit:** 17 products. Orchard and stone fruits read familiar and balanced, with a gentle sweetness that suits all-day vaping.
- **Citrus:** 17 products. Citrus flavors lead with acidity and brightness. They tend to feel light and refreshing, and they pair naturally with cooling notes.
- **Tropical:** 16 products. Tropical flavors lean sweet and aromatic, with a rounder, juicier body than most orchard fruit.

Common name pairings you will see include coastal clouds, cotton clouds and white clouds. Pairings like these are how makers keep a familiar flavor interesting: the second note changes the sweetness, acidity or finish without hiding the main flavor. clouds also appears with a cooling finish, which is covered in [how cooling ice flavors work](/blog/how-cooling-ice-flavors-work/).

## Where to find clouds
- **Vape Juice:** 75 products, from $11.99 to $14.99. [Browse vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/).

The same flavor can behave differently in each format. In a disposable, the flavor is fixed and consistent for the life of the device. In an e-liquid, you control strength, bottle size and PG/VG ratio, so you can fine-tune how the flavor comes across. In a pouch, the flavor is released slowly through the lip. Choosing the format first, then the flavor, usually leads to a better result than the other way around.

## Brands that make clouds
- **Coastal Clouds:** 71 clouds products
- **Pod Juice:** 4 clouds products

Different brands interpret clouds differently. One may lean sweet and candy-like, another tart and juicy, another cool and clean. When a brand you like also offers clouds, that is usually the safest place to start.

## Choosing the right format for clouds
Most clouds products here are vape juice. E-liquid is the flavored liquid you add to a refillable device. You choose the bottle size, the nicotine type and strength, and the PG/VG balance, which gives you more control than a disposable and often a lower cost per milliliter.

**Match the nicotine type to your hardware.** Nicotine-salt liquids are usually chosen for low-power pod systems and come in higher strengths such as 50mg, while freebase liquids suit tanks and higher wattage. See our guide to [nicotine salts vs freebase](/blog/nicotine-salts-vs-freebase/).

**Look at the PG/VG ratio.** A higher VG ratio produces bigger clouds in sub-ohm tanks, while a higher PG ratio carries flavor and suits small pods. Read more in [PG and VG ratios explained](/blog/pg-vg-ratio-explained/).

**Pick a bottle size that fits how you vape.** Larger bottles lower the cost per milliliter but leave you with more liquid to store. Our [bottle sizes guide](/blog/e-liquid-bottle-sizes-30ml-60ml-100ml/) explains the trade-offs.

**Read the label.** Strength, volume, ratio and the warning statement should all be clearly shown. Our guide to [reading an e-liquid label](/blog/how-to-read-an-e-liquid-label/) shows what to look for.

## Price range and value
Clouds products in our catalog run from $11.99 to $14.99, with an average of $13.26. Value depends on the format: compare disposables by [cost per puff](/blog/how-to-compare-vape-prices-per-puff/), bottles by price per milliliter and pouches by price per can. If you run a shop, see the [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/).

## Keeping clouds flavor fresh
Fill your device slowly and wipe the tip clean. Let a fresh coil soak for a few minutes before the first puff, and replace the coil when flavor fades or it tastes burnt. Keep bottles upright, capped and away from heat and sunlight, and store them out of reach of children and pets. See [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/). Flavor fades with heat, light and a worn coil, so store products cool and dark, and if a favorite starts to taste flat, a fresh coil or pod usually fixes it. Our guide to [fixing faded vape flavor](/blog/vape-flavor-fading-fixes/) covers the common causes.

Rotating between two or three flavors can also keep clouds tasting fresh, because your palate adapts to a flavor you vape constantly. Many adults keep clouds as a main flavor and add a seasonal or contrasting flavor alongside it.

## A buyer's checklist for clouds products
Before you place an order, run through this short list. It takes a minute and prevents most of the problems customers contact us about:

- **Confirm you are buying the right type.** A disposable, a refillable pod, a bottle of e-liquid and a pouch are different products, even when the flavor name matches.
- **Read the strength.** Compare the milligram or percentage figure with what you currently use, and start lower if you are unsure.
- **Check the options on the page.** Where a listing offers strengths or pack sizes, choose them above the Add to Cart button so the price and your order match.
- **Look at capacity and size.** Puff count, bottle volume or pouches per can tell you how long a purchase should last.
- **Compare value, not just price.** A larger device, bottle or can often costs less per puff, milliliter or pouch.
- **Have an adult ready to sign.** Delivery requires a signature from someone aged 21 or older, so choose an address where that is possible.
- **Choose your payment method early.** Cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10%, while Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime are handled through your private order page.
- **Keep your order email.** It contains the private link to your order, your tracking updates and the payment page.

## Common mistakes to avoid
- **Buying the highest strength by default.** Higher numbers are not better, and a strength that is too high for you is the most common reason people are unhappy with a purchase.
- **Ignoring compatibility.** Pods, coils and accessories are specific to a device, so match the exact product name before you order spares.
- **Storing products in the heat.** Cars, windowsills and bags left in the sun shorten the life of batteries and degrade flavor.
- **Expecting identical results from every device.** Flavor and vapor vary with the hardware and how you draw, so judge a flavor over several uses before you decide.
- **Forgetting about delivery.** A missed signature delays a parcel, so plan around the carrier's tracking updates.

## Understanding the labels and specifications
Product pages and packaging use a small set of terms repeatedly. **Nicotine strength** is shown in milligrams per milliliter or as a percentage, and 50mg is the same as 5%. **Puff count** is the manufacturer's estimate of how many draws a device can provide, and real results vary with how you use it. **Capacity** describes the volume of e-liquid in a pod or bottle. **Pack size** tells you how many units come in a listing, such as a single device or a five-pack bundle.

Reading these four figures together lets you compare any two products fairly. If two listings look similar, the one with the lower price per puff, per milliliter or per pouch is usually the better value, provided the strength is one you are comfortable with. Every product we sell is intended only for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive. title: Vape Indicator Lights: What Blinking and Color Changes Mean
summary: LED lights tell you about charge, faults and activation. Learn the common patterns and what to do when a vape blinks at you.
body:
Many devices use an LED instead of a screen. Patterns differ between makers, so check your manual, but several signals are common.

## Charging
A light while plugged in usually shows charging, changing color or turning off when full. On many devices a red light means charging and green or off means done.

## Low battery
Blinking when you inhale often means the battery is low. Charge the device if it is rechargeable. Non-rechargeable devices that blink at the end of life are done.

## Fault or protection mode
Rapid blinking can mean a short circuit, overheating or a coil problem. Stop using it and let it cool. If it continues, it may need replacement. See [how to fix a vape that will not charge](/blog/vape-wont-charge-fixes/).

## Activation
A light that flashes when you draw is normal, indicating it is firing. A fast blink on press may be a lock or cut-off.

## Modes
Devices with power modes use colors to show the mode. Check the product description.

## When the light does nothing
No light and no vapor could mean a flat battery or an empty device. See [why my vape is not hitting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/).

## Know your device
Keep the packaging or product page. Compare options in [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) that note light and screen features. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Why does my vape blink when I inhale?
faq.a: It can mean low battery, a fault or a protection feature. Check your manual.

faq.q: Is a charging light always red?
faq.a: No. Colors vary by manufacturer.

title: Auto-Draw vs Button-Fire: Which Activation Style Is Better?
summary: Some vapes fire when you inhale, others when you press a button. Compare control, convenience and typical use for each style.
body:
The way a device turns on affects how it feels and what it suits.

## Auto-draw (inhale-activated)
A sensor detects airflow and fires the coil as you draw. It is simple and intuitive. Almost all disposables and many pod systems work this way. Downsides: accidental activation if you squeeze the device, and less control over timing.

## Button-fire
You press a button to activate the coil before or while inhaling. It gives you control over when the coil heats and prevents accidental firing. Box mods and many pod kits offer it. The downside is an extra action with each puff.

## Some devices do both
A few pod kits support both modes, letting you choose.

## Which suits you
- **Simplicity:** auto-draw.
- **Control:** button-fire.
- **Travel:** button-fire, if it has a lock, reduces accidental firing in a bag.

## Considerations
Auto-draw sensors can be sensitive to blocked airflow. Keep air holes clear. See [vape not hitting](/blog/why-is-my-vape-not-hitting/) for related fixes.

## Choosing hardware
Browse [vape kits](/shop/vape-kits/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/), and read [disposable vs pod vs box mod](/blog/disposable-vs-pod-vs-box-mod/). Adults 21+ only; nicotine is addictive.

faq.q: Is auto-draw more convenient?
faq.a: Yes, because you just inhale. The trade-off is less control.

faq.q: Can button-fire prevent leaks?
faq.a: It can reduce accidental firing, which helps in bags.

title: Types of Vaporizers Explained: Pens, Portables and Desktop Units
summary: Vaporizers come in several designs. Compare pens, portables and desktop units so you can see which style fits how you plan to use one.
body:
The word "vaporizer" covers a range of devices that heat material or liquid without burning. Here are the main types.

## Vape pens
Slim, battery-powered pens heat a cartridge or a small chamber. They are discreet and easy to carry, and are suited to people who want simplicity.

## Portable vaporizers
Larger handheld devices have a heating chamber, adjustable temperature and bigger batteries. They give more control than a pen at the cost of size.

## Desktop vaporizers
Plug-in units are designed for home use. They offer precise temperature control and excellent consistency but are not portable.

## Dab and concentrate devices
Some vaporizers are designed for concentrates with specific heating elements. These are specialist products, and their legality depends on your local laws.

## Choosing
Consider portability, battery life, how easy it is to clean and the cost of replacement parts. Read reviews and manuals, and buy from a reputable seller. See [how to buy a vaporizer wisely](/shop/vaporizers/).

## Legal considerations
Products and uses are regulated differently by state, and some materials remain restricted or illegal in places. Check [state and local laws](/blog/state-and-local-vape-laws-explained/).

## Care
Clean regularly and handle batteries carefully; see [battery care](/blog/lithium-battery-care-basics-for-vapes/).

## Browse
See our [vaporizers](/shop/vaporizers/) category. Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: Is a vaporizer the same as a vape?
faq.a: They overlap. 'Vaporizer' often refers to devices that heat material or concentrates, while 'vape' often means e-liquid devices.

faq.a: Rules vary. Check your local laws before buying.

title: Vape Flavor Profiles Explained: Fruit, Dessert, Menthol and Tobacco
summary: Understand the main flavor families so you can find what suits you, from bright fruit to rich dessert and classic tobacco.
body:
Flavor names can be confusing, but most vapes fall into a handful of families.

## Fruit
The biggest group. It includes single fruits like watermelon, mango and peach and blends like berry mixes and tropical punches. Fruit flavors are bright, sweet and often tart. Our flavor guides cover [watermelon](/blog/watermelon-vape-flavors-guide/) and [blue razz](/blog/blue-razz-vape-flavors-guide/).

## Menthol and mint
Cooling, crisp flavors. Mint is herbal and sweet, menthol is sharper and cooler. Some recipes mix them with fruit.

## Dessert and bakery
Creamy, sweet and rich: custards, pastries, cakes and ice cream. They tend to have dense vapor and can leave residue on coils.

## Tobacco
Earthy, nutty or smoky profiles that aim to mimic traditional tobacco, from light to robust.

## Beverage
Cola, lemonade, coffee and tea flavors, often with citrus or cooling notes.

## Candy
Cotton candy, gummy and sour flavors. They are very sweet and popular with those who like bold taste.

## Choosing a flavor
Start with a family you like in food or drink. If you want a chill, try an [ice flavor](/blog/ice-vape-flavors-guide/). Read [best disposables for flavor lovers](/blog/best-disposable-vapes-for-flavor-lovers/).

## Browse

faq.a: Fruit blends and ice versions are among the best sellers, but tastes vary.

title: Why Is My Vape Not Hitting? 8 Causes and Quick Fixes
summary: No vapor or a weak draw is usually a simple fix. Work through these eight checks before assuming the device is dead.
body:
When a vape stops producing vapor, the cause is often easy to find. Check these in order.

## 1. Battery
A flat battery is the most common cause. Charge a rechargeable device for 20 to 30 minutes. See [how to charge a disposable](/blog/how-to-charge-a-disposable/) and [indicator lights](/blog/understanding-vape-device-indicator-lights/).

## 2. Out of liquid
Check the window or pod. A dry wick burns and gives weak or harsh vapor. Refill or replace.

## 3. Blocked airflow
Airflow holes can be covered by fingers or lint. Clean them gently.

## 4. Loose connection
Make sure the pod or tank is seated firmly and the contacts are clean. Wipe with a dry cotton bud.

## 5. Flooded coil
Too much liquid can drown the coil. Blow gently through the mouthpiece, wipe excess and wait a few minutes. See [fixing a gurgling vape](/blog/vape-gurgling-sound-fix/).

## 6. Worn coil
Coils lose performance with time. Replace it; see [how often to replace coils](/blog/how-often-to-replace-coils/).

## 7. Cold or hot temperatures
Batteries struggle in cold. Warm the device in your hand, away from heat sources.

## 8. Device lock
Some devices lock after multiple clicks. Check the manual for the unlock sequence.

## Still nothing?
Disposables cannot be repaired. If your device is faulty, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID; see the [refund policy](/refunds/). Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). Adults 21+ only.

faq.q: How long should I charge a vape?
faq.a: Most rechargeable devices need about 30 minutes to an hour for a full charge. Check the manual.

faq.q: Can I fix a dead disposable?
faq.a: Not reliably. If it has no charging port or is faulty, replacement is the usual option.
